title: When the Terminal Wakes
author: Orsen Zhou
blurb: Orsen Brightwater, a pilot bonded to an AI that lies, has spent fifteen years hauling cargo through contested orbits. But when a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep before the jump window closes.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
